thread:
Marta: Quick heads-up — Meridian renewal is in flight for 12/01. Procurement just flagged a vendor-code mismatch and paused the Docusign step. Account health is amber: onboarding week 2 still incomplete and they asked to delay final training until billing is sorted.
Devon: Ugh. Do we know which vendor code they provided?
Marta: They gave 569-ACCT, but finance expects 569-ACC-NR. Procurement asked for PO to match our vendor list.
Liam: I can confirm — PO will need to be reissued. If they can provide a revised PO with vendor code `569-ACC-NR` we can clear the payment hold.
Priya: Legal also flagged a small redline request on the payment term (they want Net 45 instead of Net 30). We need to confirm whether we can accept that for this account or escalate.
Marta: Customer is pushing Net 45 to align with their central payables. They want renewal signed this week.
Devon: I'm on it. I'll nudge procurement and ask them to reissue PO. Pinged the buyer just now: @MeridianProcurement.
Nisha: Heads-up from enablement — they've requested rescheduling the week-2 workshop to the following week if signature isn't done by Fri. Also asked for one AP-friendly training window (APAC overlap).
Marta: That's the risk — delayed training = slower adoption. Let's avoid that. Can finance accept a conditional provisional access until PO is reconciled?
Liam: We don't typically do provisional access for revenue-bearing renewals. However, we can provision temporary training access (view-only) while PO is pending. Not full prod access.
Devon: I'll offer the view-only training window to keep momentum and ask procurement for the corrected PO + sign.
Priya: If they insist on Net 45, I'll run a one-off approval with contracts — but need a documented ask from the buyer (email) and AE approval.
Marta: Ok — plan: 1) Devon to confirm PO reissue today; 2) Liam to enable provisional training access; 3) Priya to review Net 45 ask if buyer confirms; 4) I'll prepare the Docusign once PO matches.
Devon: Confirmed — I emailed the buyer and legal contact. Follow-up ETA 4pm PST.
esign-bot: Docusign envelope 0x7f9 queued pending vendor-code match — auto-hold engaged.
Liam: If PO arrives before EOD I can push the payment check through tomorrow morning.
Nisha: I'll tentatively hold the reschedule slot for week after next and share APAC-friendly times.
Marta: Thanks all. I'll capture this in the renewal playbook and share a short status update to the exec sponsor if things slide by EOD. Please drop any buyer responses here. :thumbsup:
Devon: FYI buyer replied — reissuing PO now, will include vendor code `569-ACC-NR` and note Net 45 request. Sending copy when it's out.
Marta: Excellent — once PO copy is here I'll attach to the contract and trigger Docusign.
Priya: Got it — will standby for buyer email to evaluate Net 45. If approved I'll note it in the contract addendum.
Liam: Logged the provisional training access: ticket TKT-4821. Will update when enabled.
Marta: Great. Closing loop for now. If anything slips, escalate to @VP-CS.
